SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_9q_chronic(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target_all int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	result_all int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	target  int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1519_1B0260 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  1519_1B0261 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  1519_1B0262 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	1519_1B0263 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  2059_1B0260 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  2059_1B0261 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  2059_1B0262 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  2059_1B0263 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	60_1B0282 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	60_1B0283 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	60_1B0284 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	60_1B0285 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_9q_chronic WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_9q_chronic (
SELECT @id,h.hoscode
,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
	,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543

,COUNT(DISTINCT  IF(p.age_y >=15,p.cid,NULL)) target_all
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF((((t.age_1519=1 OR t.age_2059=2 ) AND  t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263'))
				OR (t.age_60=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0282','1B0283','1B0284','1B0285')))
 ,t.cid,NULL)) result_all

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(q.2q=1,q.cid,NULL)) target

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_1519 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0260')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1519_1B0260 
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_1519 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0261') ,t.cid,NULL)) 1519_1B0261
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_1519 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0262') ,t.cid,NULL)) 1519_1B0262
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_1519 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0263') ,t.cid,NULL)) 1519_1B0263

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_2059 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0260') ,t.cid,NULL)) 2059_1B0260 
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_2059 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0261') ,t.cid,NULL)) 2059_1B0261
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_2059 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0262') ,t.cid,NULL)) 2059_1B0262
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_2059 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0263') ,t.cid,NULL)) 2059_1B0263

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0282') ,t.cid,NULL)) 60_1B0282 
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0283') ,t.cid,NULL)) 60_1B0283
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0284') ,t.cid,NULL)) 60_1B0284
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.age_60 =1 AND q.2q=1 AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0285') ,t.cid,NULL)) 60_1B0285

FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN (SELECT cid,GROUP_CONCAT(DIAGCODE ORDER BY DIAGCODE) g_chronic FROM t_chronic GROUP BY cid) 
  AS c ON p.cid=c.cid 
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_2q q  ON p.cid=q.cid AND q.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
LEFT JOIN tmp_labor l ON p.cid=l.cid AND l.bdate BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_9q t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9)  AND ISNULL(l.cid) 
GROUP BY h.hoscode);

SELECT p.hospcode, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA,p.DISCHARGE
,c.g_chronic
,t.DATE_SERV,t.PPSPECIAL
,t.PPSPLACE,t.HOSPCODE as input_hosp
,t.PROVIDER
,t.age_y
,IF(q.2q=1,'ผล2Q ผิดปกติ','') AS 2q
,IF((((t.age_1519 =1 OR t.age_2059=1)  AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0260','1B0261','1B0262','1B0263')) 
OR (t.age_60 =1 AND  t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0282','1B0283','1B0284','1B0285'))) AND q.2q=1   ,'ได้รับการประเมิน','' ) AS result

INNER JOIN (SELECT cid,GROUP_CONCAT(DIAGCODE ORDER BY DIAGCODE) g_chronic FROM t_chronic GROUP BY cid) 
  AS c ON p.cid=c.cid 
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_2q q  ON p.cid=q.cid AND q.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
LEFT JOIN tmp_labor AS l ON p.cid=l.cid  AND bdate BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
LEFT JOIN tmp_specialpp_9q t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9) AND ISNULL(l.cid)
 AND p.age_y >=15
);

h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA,d.DISCHARGE
,d.g_chronic
,d.DATE_SERV,d.PPSPECIAL
,d.PPSPLACE,d.input_hosp
,d.PROVIDER,d.age_y,d.result,d.2q
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}
